description: Class attendance with present, late, and absent toggle groups per student.

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { CheckIcon, ClockIcon, XIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Table, TableBody, TableCaption, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem, } from "@workspace/ui/components/toggle-group" const students = [ "Aiden Brooks", "Bianca Ortiz", "Caleb Nguyen", "Daria Ivanova", ] export default function AttendanceCheckTable() { const [marks, setMarks] = React.useState>({ "Aiden Brooks": "present", }) const present = Object.values(marks).filter((m) => m === "present").length return (
{present} present · {students.length - Object.keys(marks).length}{" "} unmarked Student Attendance {students.map((student) => ( {student} setMarks((m) => ({ ...m, [student]: value[0] as string })) } > ))}
) }
